t: The glucose ketone index calculator: a simple tool to monitor therapeutic efficacy for metabolic management of brain cancer - PMC
s: The ‘Glucose Ketone Index’ (GKI) was created to track the zone of metabolic management for brain tumor management. The GKI is a biomarker that refers to the molar ratio of circulating glucose over β-OHB, which is the major circulating ketone body. A mathematical tool called the Glucose Ketone Index Calculator (Additional file 1) was developed that can calculate the GKI and monitor changes in this parameter on a daily basis (Equation 1).
